note: v2.0 由目视叠加图估计得出；v3.0 用 probe_shape.py 对母版 alpha 做行列剖面实测后重标，取代目视估计值。阶段3 拆分与组装全部基于 v3.0。

envelopeRule.fit: content scaled to fit within 904x904 safe box, maximizing equally
envelopeRule.measuredAllVariants: all stage-3 assembled variants measured bbox (147,150)-(876,927), identical to master
envelopeRule.note: 极端性状（长尾/大耳）在规整后仍落回同一包络，差异体现为形状占比而非外围尺寸

measurementBasis.tailFusion: y>=500 尾巴与躯干 alpha 融合无法分离，故 tail_root 定在尾巴出口 (425,505) 而非骨盆 (420,645)

proportions.note: backTop/bellyLow measured from art; headHeight is an estimate

anchors.role: skeleton root / ground contact / translation base
body rotation center / hind leg mount
UNIQUE tail rotation center shared by every tail type; v2.0 was (430,655)=pelvis, corrected to actual tail exit
UNIQUE head-body joint / head rotation center
left ear rotation center; v2.0 was (470,350), corrected by profile
right ear rotation center; v2.0 was (790,340), corrected by profile

socketSystem.purpose: body_core 的挖空区不可留空——小部件盖不满时会露出透明洞
socketSystem.method: 挖空区用「非描边体色最近邻扩散 + 原部件高斯模糊」补色
socketSystem.pitfall: 若从描边像素扩散，挖空区会被填成近黑色，整只变剪影（阶段3 实测踩过）
socketSystem.uncoveredRate: 配套部件约 0%；阶段2 独立部件曾达 19-38%（已弃用）

partAlignmentModes.used: 阶段3 配套部件（母版变体图切出）
partAlignmentModes.rule: 1024x1024 全画布，直接 (0,0) alpha_composite，零错位、无需锚点换算

partAlignmentModes.used: 阶段2 独立部件（隔离白底表切出）
partAlignmentModes.rule: 按 rootPointInCanvas 对齐锚点 + 主轴旋转 + 母版实测尺寸归一化

invariants: tail_root is shared by tail_normal / tail_long / tail_fluffy / tail_short / tail_curl / tail_twin
neck is the only head-body joint
root / neck / tail_root / pelvis must never be moved by mods
quadruped interaction is expressed by head, ears, tail and whole-body motion - forepaws do not perform interactive gestures
